seoTitle: Fix Shopify "Sold Out" Showing With Stock Available
metaDescription: Product shows "Sold Out" on Shopify even though you have stock? Learn how to fix inventory tracking, sales channel, and availability settings.
intro: It's a frustrating problem when a Shopify product displays as "Sold Out" even though inventory is available in the backend. This usually comes down to inventory tracking errors, an unpublished sales channel, or incorrect availability settings, and this guide walks through checking each one.

steps.heading: Check inventory tracking settings
steps.body: Open the product's inventory section and confirm tracking is set up correctly and the stock count actually reflects what you have available.

steps.heading: Confirm the sales channel is published
steps.body: Verify the product is published to the sales channel customers are viewing, since an unpublished channel can make an in-stock item appear sold out there.

steps.heading: Review product availability settings
steps.body: Check that the product's availability toggle and any location-specific inventory settings are correctly enabled for the channels you're selling on.

steps.heading: Check variant-level inventory
steps.body: If the product has variants, confirm each variant individually has inventory tracked and available rather than just the parent product.

steps.heading: Save and refresh the storefront
steps.body: Save your changes and refresh the storefront page to confirm the "Sold Out" label has cleared and the product now shows as available.

faq.question: Why does Shopify show "Sold Out" when I have stock?
faq.answer: It's often caused by inventory tracking errors, an unpublished sales channel, or availability settings that don't match your actual stock.

faq.question: Could this be a variant-specific issue?
faq.answer: Yes, if a product has multiple variants, one variant could be out of stock or mistracked even while others have inventory.

faq.question: Does publishing status affect stock display?
faq.answer: Yes, if a product isn't published to the sales channel a customer is browsing, it can appear unavailable regardless of actual stock levels.

faq.question: Do I need an app to fix inventory tracking?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — most fixes happen directly in Shopify Admin's inventory and sales channel settings without needing extra apps.
